Resolves #21841

`GridHorizontalScrollSync#register()` now applies the scrollbar's current position to the centre body, the centre header, the group header and the follower rows. It does so through `syncFromScroller()`, the method `onScroll` uses. A scroll that lands before the on-demand addon has loaded, and the grid has registered, no longer leaves the body and header at 0 while the App worker holds the new position.

Evidence: L3 (a component arm in a real page with the real addon, deterministic red on `dev` and green here; a Gantt e2e case for the symptom a visitor sees; the hosted trace that found it) → L3 required (AC-1 behaviour, AC-2 regression). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 body, header and group header take the scrollbar's position at registration | CI-covered: `HorizontalScrollSyncPropagation.spec.mjs`, "a grid whose scrollbar moved before it registered takes that position at once". It reads `{body: '', header: 0}` with `dev`'s addon and `{body: '120px', header: 120}` here |
| AC-2 e2e regression | CI-covered: `LinkClip.spec.mjs`, "gantt/zoom scrolled as its first link mounts draws its links in the chart". Here it passes 9/9 (three cases, three repeats). With `dev`'s addon it failed 1 of 3 local runs, because it needs the scroll to beat the addon's load, which the hosted trace caught. The deterministic red is AC-1's arm |
| AC-3 existing specs | CI-covered: the LinkClip cases, the four `HorizontalScrollSyncPropagation` arms and the four grid unit specs that load the addon. One unit assertion changes, see below |

## Deltas from ticket

AC-2's e2e case reds on `dev` only when the race happens, so the component arm carries the deterministic red.

`HorizontalScrollSyncFollowers.spec.mjs`, "unregister ends the sync of its grid, and another grid keeps its own", expected the unregistered grid's `--grid-scroll-left` to be unset. Registration now writes the scrollbar's position, so the grid keeps the `0px` it registered with, and every CSS reader falls back to `0px`. Without the `unregister` call the assertion still fails, reading `90px`.

## Test Evidence

- **Local probe on `gantt/zoom`, scrolled at the first link's mount with `dev`'s addon.** The addon was absent at the scroll, 4 of 4 times. In 10 of 10 runs the chart showed 1 bar and 0 links, "Cure the slab" sat unscrolled at x 2813, and the body's `--grid-scroll-left` was empty. The control, scrolled after the bars render, showed 6 bars and 3 links, with "Cure the slab" at x 413.
- **Hosted trace, run 44955293678, shard 15.** The DOM held the bars and the paths at the scrolled coordinates, and the worker read 2400. Nothing painted in the chart for 4.5 s.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] LinkClip's zoom case stops failing on hosted runs. It failed on `dev` run 44951671489 and on #21832's run 44955293678.
